steps.title: Amplify gRNA Library
steps.instruction: Prepare the gRNA library via PCR amplification of the oligo pool.

substeps.instruction: Make a 1:100 dilution of the oligo pool.

Set up PCR reactions (25 µl each, 8 reactions in parallel) using Forward primer (TAACTTGAAAGTATTTCGATTTCTTGGCTTTATATATCTTGTGGAAAGGACGAAACACCG) and Reverse primer (ACTTTTTCAAGTTGATAACGGACTAGCCTTATTTTAACTTGCTATTTCTAGCTCTAAAAC).
Verify the 140 bp product by running the PCR on a 2% agarose gel.

steps.title: Prepare Lentiviral Vector
steps.instruction: Digest and purify the pLKO5.sgRNA.EFS.GFP (Addgene #57822) vector.

substeps.instruction: Digest the vector overnight at 37°C in a 50 µl reaction.
Heat-inactivate the restriction enzyme for 20 min at 65°C.
Confirm digestion by running 5 µl of the vector on an agarose gel.
Purify the DNA using the Monarch PCR & DNA Cleanup Kit and resuspend in 20 µl water.

steps.title: Transform E. coli
steps.instruction: Transform the GA reaction into electrocompetent E. coli to propagate the library.

substeps.instruction: Thaw electrocompetent E. coli cells on ice and mix by tapping.
Add 1 µl GA reaction to 25 µl E. coli (perform 3 reactions in parallel, including a digested vector-only negative control).
Transfer 25 µL of the mixture into a 1.0 mm electroporation cuvette, ensuring no bubbles, and tap to deposit cells at the bottom.
Electroporate at 25 μF, 200 Ohms, 1500 volts using a BioRad electroporator.
Immediately add 975 µL SOC medium to the cuvette and resuspend by pipetting up and down three times.
Transfer cells to a tube containing 1 mL SOC medium (total 2 mL) and shake at 250 rpm for 1 h at 37°C.
Pool the samples.

Plate 125 µL (8,000X dilution) and 375 µL (2,667X dilution) of the pooled sample (1 µl in 500 µL recovery media) onto pre-warmed 10 cm LB-Amp agar plates to estimate transformation efficiency. Repeat for the digested vector control.
Grow plates inverted for 14 h at 37°C.
Inoculate 3 Erlenmeyer flasks with 100 ml LB-Amp each from the pooled sample and grow overnight at 37°C with shaking.
For the digested vector control, plate the remaining undiluted culture on one LB-Amp agar plate.

steps.title: Isolate and Validate Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Extract plasmid DNA and verify library quality.

substeps.instruction: Isolate plasmid DNA from Midiprep cultures using the Monarch Plasmid Miniprep kit and elute in 50 µl.
Perform Sanger sequencing (expect 10 unique guides).
Assess quality and completeness of library preps using NGS.

steps.title: Produce Lentivirus
steps.instruction: Generate lentiviral particles via transfection of HEK293T cells.

substeps.instruction: Seed HEK293T cells in 15cm dishes (16 ml DMEM complete) 24 h prior to transfection.
At 80% confluency, mix 8.75 μg VSVG, 16.25 μg psPAX2, and 25 μg lentiviral vector in 1 ml additive-free DMEM.
Add 150 μg linear polyethylenimine (PEI) and mix by inverting.
Change media to fresh DMEM complete 16–24 h post-transfection.
Collect the first batch of supernatant 48 h post-transfection and replace with 16 ml fresh DMEM complete.
Collect the second batch of supernatant 72 h post-transfection and pool with the first batch.
Spin down at 4000xg for 5 min to remove cells and debris.
Transfer 27 ml of supernatant to an ultracentrifugation tube and slowly add 5 ml of 20% sucrose to the bottom.
Ultracentrifuge at 24000 rpm for 2 h at 4 ºC.
Discard supernatant, let the pellet dry for ~3 min, resuspend in 160 µl DMEM or DPBS, and store 20 µl aliquots at -80°C.

steps.title: Determine Optimal MOI
steps.instruction: Titrate the lentivirus on NALM6 cells to achieve 30% transduction efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Seed 2.5 x 10^5 NALM6 ABE8e or NALM6 EvoCDA cells in 24-well plates (500 µl RPMI complete/well).
Transduce in duplicate with 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, and 8 µL of lentivirus.
Change media 3 days post-transduction to remove virus; add more media to expand cells when confluent.
Assess GFP+ percentage via flow cytometry 7 days post-transduction.
Use linear regression to determine the volume required for 30% transduction efficiency (MOI = 0.3).

steps.title: Perform Base Editor Screen
steps.instruction: Transduce NALM6 cells with the lentiviral library and collect for sorting.

substeps.instruction: Seed 3 replicates of 5–7.5x10^6 NALM6 ABE8e or NALM6 EvoCDA cells in T25 flasks (10-15 ml RPMI complete) and transduce with the lentiviral library or sg218-only.
Change media 3 days post-transduction to remove virus and expand cells to 15-20 ml in T25 flasks.
Collect and count all cells 7 days post-transduction.
Wash cells once in 3 ml DPBS.
Strain through a 35 µm nylon mesh and resuspend in 1 ml DPBS (10x10^6 cells) for sorting.
Collect sorted cells in DPBS and store on ice.
Pellet cells at 2000xg for 5 min.
Resuspend in 200 µl DPBS and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Libraries
steps.instruction: Amplify gRNA and endogenous enhancer regions for NGS analysis.

substeps.instruction: For gRNA-based libraries: Perform PCR1 to attach overhangs using F: AATGGACTATCATATGCTTACCGTAACTTGAAAGTATTTCG and R: CTTTAGTTTGTATGTCTGTTGCTATTATGTCTACTATTCTTTCCC (25 µl, 8 reactions/sample).
For gRNA-based libraries: Perform PCR2 to attach Illumina adapters and barcodes using unique forward/reverse primer combinations (25 µl, 8 reactions/sample).
For allele-based libraries: Perform PCR1 to attach overhangs using F: CTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTACATGCTCTAGTGAAAGCCAGT and R: AGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCTGCACTCTCTATGTGCCTCTGTGT (25 µl, 8 reactions/sample).
For allele-based libraries: Perform PCR2 to attach Illumina adapters and barcodes using unique forward/reverse primer combinations (25 µl, 8 reactions/sample).
Mix 75 µl PCR product with 15 µl 6x loading dye.
Load 45 µl per pocket (2 adjacent pockets) on a 2% agarose gel, leaving one empty pocket between samples; run for 45 min.
Extract the 350 bp band using the GeneJET Gel Extraction Kit and elute in 50 µl.
Pool libraries and perform a quality check via Tapestation.
Perform Illumina paired-end sequencing and demultiplex based on P7 and P5 indices.
